sentences.text:
Mr. Ganesh Umale, Advocate for respondent nos.1 and 2
 Mr. N. P. Lambat, Advocate for respondent no.3
 Coram : G. A. Sanap, J.
Date : March 12, 2024.

1. Heard Mr. Amol B. Patil, learned advocate for the ap- pellants.
2.
This is an application for condonation of 178 days delay caused in filing appeal against the impugned judgment and award dated 12.06.2019, passed by the Reference Court.
The reasons have been stated in the application.

3. In view of the decision in the case of New Okhla In- dustrial Development Authority Vs.
Rameshwar @ Ramesh Chandra Sharma (Dead), through Legal Heir and another (2022 SCC Online SC 1599), delay can be condoned, subject to condition that the original land owners/claimants/
appel- lants herein shall not be entitled to get any statutory benefits, including the interest payable under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 on the enhanced amount of compensation for the 2 28j Prashant S/O Nagorao Vitalkar vs State Of Maharashtra Thr. Collector, ...

1 caf1773.23.odt delayed period.
4.
Learned advocate for the applicant/appellant submits that the Court may pass an appropriate order.
5. In view of the above, the application is allowed.
De- lay of 178 days caused in filing appeal stands condoned.

6. It is made clear that the original land owners/ claimants/appellants herein shall not be entitled to get any statutory benefits, including the interest payable under the Land Acquisition Act on the enhanced amount of compensa- tion for the delayed period of 178 days, in case the appeal is allowed.
7. The appeal be registered.
8. The application stands disposed of, accordingly.

First Appeal St. No. 11104 of 2020 1. Heard.
2. ADMIT.
3.

Learned Assistant Government Pleader waives service of notice on behalf of respondent nos.1 and 2.
4.
Mr. Nitin P. Lambat, waives service of notice on be- half of respondent no.3.

5. List this appeal with First Appeal Nos.678/2022, 27/2021, 32/2021, 1259/2019, 1261/2019 and 1724/2019, on 19.03.2024.
